page: Microsoft Azure DC4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes 154 GB of local disk storage. Additionally, the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage for workloads requiring enhanced disk performance. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no onboard graphics processing units (GPUs) configured.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio position this instance as a stable option for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of GPU acceleration. The combination of dedicated AMD vCPUs, 16.0 GB of RAM, and local storage makes this server suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, and small-scale database hosting where predictable resource availability is required.
